title: EEG responses to continuous naturalistic speech
description: This dataset contains 128-channel EEG recordings from healthy, neurotypical adults listening to naturalistic continuous speech, specifically segments of an audiobook version of "The Old Man and the Sea". It combines data from two earlier studies on cortical entrainment to speech and on semantic processing. It includes the audio stimuli and forced-aligned word and phoneme timing files, supporting research on speech and language processing.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a 128-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system at 512 Hz. Recordings are unfiltered and unreferenced, with one recording per audiobook segment. Recording starts are aligned to the audio onset, and the recordings extend beyond the audio to a varying extent. Word and phoneme timings in the stimulus TextGrid files were generated with the Prosodylab-Aligner forced aligner and inspected by eye.
